name: Winter Frost
description: Pale stars in icy blues on a deep slate sky.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Pale icy stars on a deep blue background, shown on Creative Toy.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Make a picture, or just play with the colours.
howToPlay: Click the canvas, or move with the arrow keys and press Space, to place a star.
Pick a colour with the number keys or the round swatches.
Press Undo to take the last star back, or Clear to start over.
tips: Your picture stays on this device and cannot be exported.
